notes.title: VN House New Release - Lovers in Playa Rosa

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35196957/d833a2c17aab0643a824fd56bcdbc99a3d968b55.gif[/img]

We have some exciting news to share with you. We are proud to announce the release of a new VN Hiuse game, "Lovers in Playa Rosa."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344040/Lovers_in_Playa_Rosa/

[h2]Get it now with a 20% Launch Discount[/h2]

"Lovers in Playa Rosa" is a romantic comedy visual novel and yuri dating sim that follows the journey of our protagonist, Tina Lee, a hard-working barkeeper who travels to Mexico to seek better opportunities and explore the joys of lesbian love.With its engaging storyline, charming characters, and beautiful artwork,

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35196957/479f1fa7b889724aa53c72aed5a1dae308a82652.png[/img]

 "Lovers in Playa Rosa" promises to be a delightful and immersive gaming experience. You will find yourself captivated by the various romantic escapades and unexpected twists and turns that await you in the sunny and vibrant setting of Playa Rosa.

Whether you're a fan of visual novels, dating sims, or romantic comedies, "Lovers in Playa Rosa" is a game that you simply cannot afford to miss.
